verdict.rationale: FreshBooks documents a broad first-party REST API covering clients, invoices, payments, expenses, bills, taxes, journal entries and reports, with OAuth scopes, webhooks and an official SDK. That is real API coverage of much of the accounting surface. Nothing shows UI parity, though: several UI features have no documented API equivalent, and Bill Vendors is only in beta. missing for 10: evidence of API endpoints for estimates, payroll, bank reconciliation, Bill Pay scheduling and execution, and team/accountant access management; an explicit UI-parity statement; independent or hands-on corroboration of coverage.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
